name: Payments in and out the same day with thin margin
description: Funds received from buyer are paid onward to supplier, often same day, leaving little retained.
fp: Distributors and agents may operate on thin margins and pass-through.

links.name: Payments in and out the same day with thin margin
links.ctx: A group trading or principal entity receives and re-pays amounts the same day with a thin margin, acting as a conduit for profit.
